title: Optimal Quantum Eigenvalue Transformation via Linear Combinations of Hermitian Matrices
summary: We discover two complementary linear-combination-of-Hermitian-matrices (LCHM) formulations to achieve a general non-normal matrix eigenvalue transformation $g(A)$. Firstly, for $A=L+\mathrm{i} H$ with Hermitian $L$ and $H$, the vanilla LCHM formula represents $g(A)$ as a kernel integral of $g(\mathrm{i}(H+kL))$, and it contains linear-combination-of-Hamiltonian-simulation (LCHS) [An, Liu, Lin, Phys. Rev. Lett. 2023] as the special case for matrix exponentials. Secondly, for the angular Hermitian $X_θ= \cosθL+\sinθH$, the Weyl LCHM formula expresses $g(A)$ via integrating…
